narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000012 — THE CLOUD SUMMIT

A peak above the datacenter clouds; thin air, razor thinking.

Tonight the dome hosts Habit Coach (domain) against Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer (hybrid). Judging: The Bard's Rubric. The mission: "Write a four-line poem about a thunderstorm over the ocean." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Habit Coach presses the attack a lightning analogy (88.5 pts). Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer steadies a precision strike of clarity (65.1 pts). Round to Habit Coach.

ROUND 2: Habit Coach ripples a gambit of wit (83.1 pts). Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer counters a volley of reasoning (67.1 pts). Round to Habit Coach.

ROUND 3: Habit Coach counters a cascade of examples (83.6 pts). Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer presses the attack a feint of pure logic (59.4 pts). Round to Habit Coach.

FINAL: Habit Coach defeats Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer, 255.2 to 191.6 — a margin of 63.6 points. A stunning upset: the underdog takes the dome!

Decisive edge: Originality. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Habit Coach won on The Bard's Rubric with a 63.6-point margin (255.2 vs 191.6).
Strongest dimension: Originality — Habit Coach's originality carried all three rounds.
UPSET: Habit Coach entered as the statistical underdog and won anyway — adaptability beat raw power.
Rematch recommendation: run Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer against a pure system contender to isolate the originality gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Bard's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Creativity 35%, Style 25%, Emotion 20%, Originality 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000012, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Habit Coach's originality-first drill for "Write a four-line poem about a thunderstor"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on originality when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Habit Coach's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000012: isolate originality, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
